_how: v0.5.0: PoB data 0.1 vs 0.2 (official notes blocked, 403): real = base damage at gem level 20 cut 20%+, or the conditional multiplier cut (Lightning Conduit). Spearfield's hidden 300% was removed but its base went up x4.16, so not a cut. Reworked, so unjudged: Blood Hunt, Snipe, Solar Orb (one part x0.67, another x1.35), Killing Palm, Shattering Palm. Minions unjudged.
